run_process_batch: run the PRM800K dataset processing script to transform raw JSONL data into stepwise supervision format
process_example: process a single PRM800K example into prompt, completions, and labels for stepwise supervision
run_process_example: run the PRM800K example processor to convert raw step-level data into training-ready format
run_script_arguments: run the PRM800K dataset generation script with configurable push_to_hub and dataset_num_proc arguments
run_load_dataset: run the PRM800K dataset loader to fetch and map training and test JSONL files from OpenAI's repo
